Ostomachion — simple (11-piece) game — 268 unlabeled solutions

Home · Each tiling drawn on the 12×12 grid; congruent pieces A/B and D/E and G/K treated as interchangeable; mirrors and rotations merged. Dots mark mirror-flipped pieces. Click letters to toggle pieces on or off across every tiling (several can be on at once); “All” toggles between all and none. Piece orientations are shown while exactly one piece is selected. Flip table · Spanning-cut cases · all diagonals
